lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows with increasing spot diameter towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible in the post-gill region, intersecting with the primary horizontal spot rows to form a loose rectangular coordinate system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast transition from a light-colored dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral trough.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent reddish-pink circular lesion or mark is located on the lower flank, posterior to the final gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The anterior cephalic region exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-spots that are significantly smaller and more densely packed than the primary lateral flank blobs.
